rows.speaker: Meio Plato

rows.en: But for that, I must deal with this lot right now...!

rows.en: That's... the Blue Hawk of Giganos!?
Three of them are headed your way!
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: One day, I will strike you down myself.

rows.en: Dan! Karl! Welner!
rows.speaker: Meio Plato

rows.en: You bastards... My name is Meio Plato!
rows.speaker: Meio Plato

rows.en: ...and I will avenge them!
rows.speaker: Meio Plato

rows.en: So that's Giganos's prized ace pilot.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: That's one tough opponent. Be careful!
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Ngh... I will have my revenge, mark my words...!
